title: Small bar licence (Western Australia)
summary: From 7 May 2007 WA offered a small bar licence for venues of up to 120 people.

instruments.title: Liquor and Gaming Legislation Amendment Act 2006

commenced.what: Part 2 commenced, including the small bar licence

direction_rationale: A small-bar licence class with lower fees and simpler requirements lowers the cost of opening a small venue, allowing entry by small operators that a full hotel or tavern licence would deter.
comparison: States without a small-bar class at each date (VIC, QLD and TAS had their own regimes: to check)
confounders: liquor licensing reforms of 2007 in the same Act

verified.notes: Read on the WA register: proclamation of 24 April 2007 (Gazette 1 May 2007) commenced Part 2 on 7 May 2007.
